training_scope: existing train80 songs, 80 dry and 240 train-RIR mixtures; no source targets or validation labels in fitting
feature_window: central26s of existing30s cache or40s evaluation input, excluding synthesis guards and outer2s of original30s crop
features: 12 normalized log-band powers, 6 stereo coherence magnitudes, spectral flatness quantiles, spectral flux, envelope autocorrelation/shape
classifier: balanced L2 logistic regression, training-only standardization, Newton optimization
threshold_meaning: fixed conservative sigmoid score, not a calibrated probability guarantee
decision: hybrid if score>=0.8, otherwise existing ensemble; one choice per whole case
validation_scope: same exposed validation10 songs dry/wet_R4=20 cases
candidate_hybrid: vocals/other from ensemble, drums/bass from fine-tuned SCNet step1000
primary: wet paired-song mean four-stem SI-SDR gain median>=0.2dB and95%CI lower>0
limitations: condition classifier is not a quality oracle
same validation already used for design
synthetic RIR classification does not establish real-recording reverberation detection
